manual_notes: TOON/JSON views, derived header metadata, formatting-aware edit support and parity tests are present. Strict session-stable style IDs are unresolved: discoverStyles rebuilds names in first-seen fingerprint order with a fresh counter after cache invalidation. An earlier paragraph changing to a new body fingerprint can renumber the style of a later unchanged paragraph. The repeated-read test does not cover this edit-between-reads case.
